name: Crownbean Export Orders for WooCommerce
author: crownbean

sections.description:
Crownbean Export Orders for WooCommerce lets you export your WooCommerce orders easily with custom filters and formats.

Free Version Features

  • Export WooCommerce orders to CSV format.
  • Filter by date range, order status, or customer.
  • Choose which order fields to include in your export.
  • Simple, one-click export directly from the admin page.

Upgrade to Pro

An optional Pro version is available that adds features such as:
– Additional export formats (XLSX, JSON)
– Scheduled exports and automated email delivery
– Advanced filtering options

The free version of Crownbean Export Orders for WooCommerce includes all core export functionality.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/crownbean-export-orders-for-woocommerce/, or install it via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. The plugin adds an Export Orders admin menu item under WooCommerce.
sections.faq:
Does the free version require setup?

No setup required. Once activated, the export page appears under the WooCommerce admin menu.

Can I export to Excel (XLSX) or JSON?

Those export formats are included in the Pro version.

Does this plugin modify my orders or database?

No. The plugin only reads WooCommerce order data for export and does not change or write to the database.

Can I schedule exports automatically?

Yes, in the Pro version — you can schedule exports with custom filters and email them automatically.
